scientific_rationale: high-pressure methane uptake is selected as the confirmatory geometry-dominant regime; endpoint choice was made before reading uptake values and not from observed effect size

pair_orientation.rule: use the already-frozen Step 2.3 driver descriptor; orient each pair from the lower driver-descriptor value to the higher value

primary_population_summary.dependence_unit: one frozen architecture family / primary pair

supporting_same_endpoint_metrics: fraction of pairs with positive signed uptake difference
signed symmetric relative difference: 2*(q_high-q_low)/(abs(q_high)+abs(q_low)); 0 when both are zero
signed log uptake ratio log(q_high/q_low), reported only when both values are strictly positive

secondary_program.conditions: all remaining adsorption gas/T/p conditions including CH4 at 5.8 bar

missing_data_rule: no imputation; a pair contributes to an endpoint only when both frozen members have observed values for that endpoint
